name: Temporal Kernel — Hash-Chained Workflow Orchestration Node
one_line_value_proposition: Deterministic state-machine workflows over an append-only, hash-chained SQLite event log with lease fencing and logical rollback.
buyer_problem: Teams that need durable, auditable workflow execution often adopt heavy infrastructure for what is a small state-machine problem.
solution_summary_public: Machines are pure-data specs; each state owns a task; nodes claim tasks with a lease and monotonic fence; completions with stale fences are rejected; checkpoints record a state hash; rollback is logical and never rewrites history.
differentiators_public: Failover safety via monotonic fence tokens — a stale node cannot corrupt state.
State is derived only from the log, so every node derives identical state; replay raises on divergence.
verified_capabilities: Runnable demo shows lease, node death, recovery and fence increment (`python3 -m tkernel demo`).
Optional per-event HMAC; `verify` command exits 1 on corruption.
unverified_claims: Multi-node behavior on a shared network volume; CI status was not inspected in this review.

segments: Teams embedding workflow execution in a product

public.headline: Durable workflows where state is a pure fold of a tamper-evident log.
public.subheadline: Temporal Kernel runs state-machine workflows whose entire state is replayed from an append-only, hash-chained log, with fence tokens that stop zombie nodes after failover.
public.cost_of_inaction: Not applicable as a market claim; the value is a small, auditable orchestration core. No statistic is cited.
public_limitations: SQLite single writer; no network replication or consensus.
Replay is full-history for a cold node; no snapshot fast-start.
Timers and signals are not implemented; rolled-back side effects are not undone.
architecture_public: Machine spec → Node (claim / complete / fail / heartbeat) → EventLog (hash-chained, SQLite triggers reject UPDATE/DELETE) → pure replay → checkpoints.
public.risk_summary: Single-writer SQLite; missing timers/signals; ownership and AI-authorship review pending; no revenue or customers.

demo.title: Lease, crash, recover — watch the fence token advance
steps: Node A leases a task with fence 2.
Node A dies; Node B recovers and leases with fence 3.
The workflow finishes with 11 recorded events.
